title: sales.order.add_line / sales.order.add_open_line
description: Adds one line to an open check (ADR-0141). The payload is FLAT and carries the line's optional columns (unit context, supplements, set menu, note…), so the rest of the shape goes through untouched; what this schema closes is the quantity (sales#401): the handler reads it with a lenient parse, and a float or a decimal string fell back to ONE unit with HTTP 200 — an API client asking for 2,5 got 1. The step the line declares is still enforced by the handler (`sales.quantity_off_grid`).

quantity.description: Quantity in fixed-point INTEGER, global scale 10^6 (ADR-0147): 1 unit = 1000000, 2,5 = 2500000. Never a float nor a string. Omit it (or send null) for one unit.
